name: GeoAgent Multimodal Geospatial Agent
description: Mirror of opengeos/GeoAgent (v1.8.0): a Strands-Agents-based geospatial agent layer that binds LLMs (OpenAI, Codex OAuth, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, LiteLLM, Ollama) to live maps (leafmap, anymap, browser MapLibre), QGIS sessions and Earth-observation catalogs (STAC, NASA Earthdata/OPERA, GEE data catalogs, Vantor, HyperCoast, WhiteboxTools, geoai). It ships a Python API, a CLI, a Solara UI, a FastAPI WebSocket backend for browser maps, a Node/TypeScript example backend and the OpenGeoAgent QGIS plugin, with confirmation hooks before destructive or expensive tool calls. In the Notations Universe it is the geospatial perception-and-planning engine that can drive map views and catalog searches; it is an upstream mirror and must never hold canonical world state.

capabilities.label: GeoAgent.chat / stream_chat / chat_in_background
capabilities.description: Python API: run one user turn (text, or multimodal content blocks with images) through the bound Strands agent and return a GeoAgentResponse (answer_text, tool_calls, images); stream_chat yields events; chat_in_background runs on a worker thread. QGIS calls are marshalled to the GUI thread.

capabilities.label: GeoAgentConfig and provider resolution
capabilities.description: Python API: GeoAgentConfig(provider, model, temperature, max_tokens, client settings); resolve_model/get_llm/get_default_model pick a provider from environment variables (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, LITELLM_*, OLLAMA_HOST) or explicit arguments.

capabilities.label: @geo_tool decorator and GeoToolRegistry
capabilities.description: Python API for downstream packages: @geo_tool turns a function into a Strands tool with category, safety flags (needs_confirmation) and fast-mode metadata; GeoToolRegistry lists and filters tools.

capabilities.label: Confirmation hooks
capabilities.description: Python API: ConfirmCallback/ConfirmRequest, auto_approve_all, auto_approve_safe_only and build_interrupt_on pause the agent before deleting layers, saving files or running expensive jobs; the default policy denies confirmation-required tools.

capabilities.label: create_agent with custom tools
capabilities.description: Factory for package-specific integrations: build a GeoAgent from an explicit tool list, context objects and model.

capabilities.label: for_leafmap / for_anymap map control
capabilities.description: Binds the agent to a live leafmap or anymap map with tools to inspect state and layers, navigate (set_center, fly_to, zoom_*), manage layers, add vector/GeoJSON/raster/COG/STAC/XYZ/PMTiles data and markers, change basemap and save_map. Layer removal and save are confirmation-gated.
capabilities.side_effects: mutates map widget; may write files

capabilities.label: for_qgis QGIS session control
capabilities.description: Binds the agent to qgis.utils.iface and a QgsProject with tools: list_project_layers, get_project_state, inspect_layer_fields, get_selected_features, zoom/scale/center navigation, add_vector_layer/add_raster_layer/add_xyz_tile_layer, remove_layer, visibility/opacity, select_features_by_expression, run_processing_algorithm, open_attribute_table, save_project and the confirmation-gated run_pyqgis_script fallback.

capabilities.label: for_stac STAC catalog search
capabilities.description: Tools: get_current_stac_search_extent, list_stac_collections, search_stac_items, get_stac_item_assets, add_stac_asset_to_qgis against pystac-client catalogs (Planetary Computer and others).

capabilities.label: for_nasa_earthdata Earthdata search and load
capabilities.description: Tools: search_earthdata_catalog, get_earthdata_dataset_info, search_earthdata_data, display_earthdata_footprints, load_earthdata_raster, create_earthdata_rgb_composite via earthaccess; opens NASA Earthdata panels in QGIS.

capabilities.label: for_nasa_opera OPERA products
capabilities.description: Tools: get_available_datasets, get_dataset_info, search_opera_data, display_footprints, display_raster, create_mosaic; submit_nasa_opera_search_task runs a search as a QGIS task without an LLM.

capabilities.label: for_gee_data_catalogs Earth Engine catalogs
capabilities.description: Binds Google Earth Engine data catalog search and geemap display tools (requires earthengine-api credentials).

capabilities.label: for_vantor Vantor open data
capabilities.description: Tool search_vantor_items over the Vantor open-data STAC catalog.

capabilities.label: for_hypercoast hyperspectral data
capabilities.description: Tools: list_hypercoast_data_types, search_hypercoast_data, get_selected_hypercoast_footprints, preview_hypercoast_dataset, open_hypercoast_panel.

capabilities.label: for_whitebox terrain and hydrology processing
capabilities.description: Binds WhiteboxTools geoprocessing (terrain analysis, hydrology) as agent tools; runs local compute jobs.

capabilities.label: for_geoai deep-learning geospatial tools
capabilities.description: Binds the geoai package (segmentation, detection, download helpers) as agent tools.

capabilities.label: for_timelapse animated timelapses
capabilities.description: Binds timelapse generation tools (satellite time series to animation) built on geemap/leafmap.

capabilities.label: HydroSovereign (hsae) tools
capabilities.description: Optional extra binding hydrosovereign hydrology tools (examples/hsae_demo.py).

capabilities.label: Image tools and generate_image
capabilities.description: Multimodal helpers: image content blocks in chat, screenshot artifacts, and generate_image via OpenAI when OPENAI_API_KEY is configured.

capabilities.label: ChatGPT/Codex OAuth login
capabilities.description: login_openai_codex, ensure_openai_codex_environment, is_openai_codex_logged_in, clear_openai_codex_token store a refresh token in the user config dir and export OPENAI_CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN.

capabilities.label: geoagent CLI
capabilities.description: geoagent ui (Solara workspace), geoagent browser --host --port --provider --model [--allow-browser-code] [--auto-approve-browser-tools] (FastAPI backend), geoagent codex login|status|logout.

capabilities.label: Browser backend health
capabilities.description: GET /geoagent/health returns {ok: true} from the FastAPI browser backend (default 127.0.0.1:8765).

capabilities.label: Browser MapLibre WebSocket protocol
capabilities.description: WS /geoagent/ws: server sends {type:session, sessionId, mapId}; client sends {type:chat, message, mapId, history}; server streams {type:map_command,...} instructions that the browser executes on a live MapLibre map and answers with map_command_result; turn ends with chat_result. One chat turn per session at a time; run_maplibre_script only with --allow-browser-code.

capabilities.label: for_browser_maplibre tool surface
capabilities.description: Tools executed through the browser session: list_layers, get_map_state, set_center, fly_to, set_zoom, zoom_to_bounds, change_basemap, add_marker, add_geojson_data, add_vector_data, add_xyz_tile_layer, set_layer_visibility, set_layer_opacity, query_rendered_features, screenshot_map, remove_layer, clear_layers.

capabilities.label: Node/TypeScript MapLibre backend example
capabilities.description: examples/node_maplibre_strands_typescript: Express + ws server on 127.0.0.1:8765 serving the static MapLibre page, GET /geoagent/health and a WebSocket with the same session/chat/map_command protocol, using @strands-agents/sdk with server-side provider auth (Codex OAuth, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, LiteLLM, Ollama).

capabilities.label: Solara map-chat workspace
capabilities.description: geoagent ui opens a Solara app (home and chat pages) bound to an anymap or leafmap map with provider/model controls, fast mode, chat history, compact tool results and a conservative confirmation policy.

capabilities.label: OpenGeoAgent QGIS plugin
capabilities.description: Dockable QGIS chat panel (QGIS 3.28 to 4.x) with agent modes (General QGIS, WhiteboxTools, NASA Earthdata, NASA OPERA, GEE catalogs, STAC), tool permission profiles, voice prompts, image paste and screenshot attachments, Markdown history import/export, a jobs panel, provider settings and a dependency installer into ~/.open_geoagent/.

capabilities.label: Example notebooks
capabilities.description: docs/examples notebooks: intro, live_mapping, openai_codex, qgis_agent, stac_workflow, stream_chat_openai_codex; site published at geoagent.gishub.org.

metadata.person_data_note: Earth-observation imagery can show people; nothing is stored or indexed.

relations.description: Inferred from purpose and a documented design lineage, not confirmed by a runtime call: GeoAgent drives MapLibre/leafmap views and EO catalog searches from natural language, which is the kind of geospatial reasoning the PAYLOAD EARTH globe could consume as layers or camera commands. Payload-Render-Engine cites the GeoAgent pattern for its structured tool surface (src/app/toolSurface.ts, src/main.ts, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), but no file in this repository references the render engine and neither imports or calls the other.
relations.evidence: geoagent/tools/browser_maplibre.py; geoagent/browser/server.py; Payload-Render-Engine src/app/toolSurface.ts and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ('GeoAgent pattern'); no call path

environment.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environment.purpose: OpenAI access for the default Strands model provider.

environment.name: OPENAI_CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN
environment.purpose: OAuth access token for the Codex provider path, used instead of an API key where the account is OAuth-bound.

environment.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environment.purpose: Claude access for the Anthropic model provider.

environment.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environment.purpose: Google AI Studio access for the Gemini provider.

environment.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
environment.purpose: The alternate spelling the same Google SDK accepts; either name reaches the same Gemini provider, and naming both is how a key ends up provisioned twice.

environment.name: LITELLM_API_KEY
environment.purpose: Bearer for a LiteLLM gateway when the estate routes model calls through one rather than to a provider directly.

environment.name: LITELLM_BASE_URL
environment.purpose: Base URL of that gateway. A network location, not a credential.

environment.name: OLLAMA_HOST
environment.purpose: Host of a local Ollama server for the offline model path.

environment.name: BEDROCK_MODEL
environment.purpose: Model identifier for the AWS Bedrock provider; the credentials come from the AWS chain, not from here.

environment.name: AWS_PROFILE
environment.purpose: Names which profile in the AWS credential chain to use. It selects a credential; it is not one.

environment.name: EARTHDATA_USERNAME
environment.purpose: NASA Earthdata login used by earthaccess to authorise CMR granule downloads.

environment.name: EARTHDATA_PASSWORD
environment.purpose: The password half of that Earthdata login.

reference.spatial: Operates on whatever map extent, layers and bounding boxes the bound map, QGIS project or catalog search carries; no fixed site of its own.
reference.temporal: Catalog searches take start/end date ranges; timelapse tools build satellite time series; otherwise per-session chat history only.
open_questions: No MCP client or server surface was found in the repo (grep for 'mcp' returns nothing); the 'MCP usage' expected by the brief does not exist at this commit.
Which map surface will the universe drive: the Python browser backend, the Node example backend, or the QGIS plugin?
The fork tracks upstream at a8aaa82 (2026-05-13); no first-party changes were found.

corpus.holding: No corpus. It searches Earth-observation catalogs on demand and drives map views; nothing is stored.

COR-004.note: Catalog searches take explicit start and end date ranges, so what was asked for is recoverable from the request.

COR-006.note: Confirmation hooks gate destructive or expensive tool calls.

COR-007.note: Search results are used and discarded; nothing is captured, so a scene that changes upstream cannot be re-examined.

COR-010.note: An upstream mirror that must never hold canonical world state.
